title: Yeh Karbala Hai, Zulm-o-Sitam Ki Intaha Hai
body:
Kahi Phay Sur Hai Kahi Rida Hai (x2)
Yeh Karbala Hai, Yeh Karbala Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghazi Nahi Hain Akbar Nahi Hai,
Qasim Nahi Hain Asghar Nahi Hai (x2)
Aur Shah Ka Lasha Tanha Para Hai (x2)
Yeh Karbala Hai, Yeh Karbala Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kerkay Dafan Masoom Asghar,
Shabbir Roye Nani Qabar Par (x2)
Asghar Ke Khun Se Chehra Bhara Hai (x2)
Yeh Karbala Hai, Yeh Karbala Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhono Jahan Mutthi Mei Jiskay,
Maqtal Mei Pyasa Shabbir Hain Woh (x2)
Hal Min Ki Tanha Deyta Sada Hai (x2)
Yeh Karbala Hai, Yeh Karbala Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal Mai Hain Joh Fakhray Yousuf,
Hum Shaqal Ahmad Hai Naam Akbar (x2)
Seenei Mei Uskay Tooti Sina Hai (x2)
Yeh Karbala Hai, Yeh Karbala Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Islam Ki Khatir Luta Hai,
Johar Mohammed Ka Hain Ghirana (x2)
Ab Sham Lut Nei Ghar Yeh Chala Hai (x2)
Yeh Karbala Hai, Yeh Karbala Hai
